extension.news: 1.1.0: JPEG logos converted too; runs at startup and when Cumination is opened instead of every 30 minutes; fixes for Windows thumbnail cache and write errors
extension.summary: Shows Cumination's site logos properly in poster views (Bingie and other skins)
extension.description: Cumination's site logos are wide banners. Skins that fit poster art into a fixed 2:3 frame, such as Bingie's poster views, stretch them out of shape. This service rebuilds each PNG and JPEG logo as a 2:3 poster: the logo undistorted in the middle (small logos enlarged smoothly), on a card in the logo's own background colour (or a light or dark card for transparent logos), kept inside the central 16:9 band so landscape and square views still show it whole. It checks once when Kodi starts and once each time Cumination is opened, so posters are re-applied after Cumination updates. Originals are backed up and can be restored from the settings. GIF and WebP logos are left as they are.
